verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban runs many coding agents in parallel from a task board, with per-card isolated git worktrees, auto-commit and dependency chains. YOLO/auto-approve and headless CLI mode let those agents act without prompts, and cron-scheduled agents persist across restarts independently of any terminal session. Missing for 10: evidence that agents sustain autonomous work for hours or days (the only hands-on report describes a lunch-length run), independent or hands-on corroboration of Kanban fleet operation, and evidence of cloud or remote fleet execution beyond the local machine.
